title: 4-Year-Old Stabbed by Aunt During Family Dispute (Police Bodycam)
description:
On August 23rd, 2024. Police responded to a situation involving a 4-year-old who had been stabbed by her aunty. The child later had surgery and was in stable condition. This is body-cam footage of the events.
